book_name: 思思大王高考单词一笑而过

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: He gave a quick preview of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要预看了这部电影。
words.en: A preview is an opportunity to see something such as a film or a collection of works of art before it is open to the public.

words.ex: Fifty percent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: A percent is a unit of measure equal to one hundredth of a whole. It is often used to express proportions, rates, and comparisons in various contexts, such as finance, statistics, and everyday calculations.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: The boy has an abnormal heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的心跳不正常。
words.en: Deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的看法。
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢吃西兰花。
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: They will liberate the prisoners tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会释放这些囚犯。
words.en: To liberate a place or the people in it means to free them from the political or military control of another country, area, or group of people.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.ex: He tries to simplify the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简化这个数学问题。
words.en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things that make it complex.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.ex: I recognize her face from school.
words.ex_cn: 我从学校认出了她的脸。
words.en: If you recognize someone or something, you know who or what they are because you have seen or heard them before.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: The national flag flies high every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上国旗都高高飘扬。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.ex: He felt deep pain from his friend's betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 他因朋友的背叛感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: The action of betraying one's country, a group, or a person; treachery.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr: adj. 有技巧的；熟练的；灵巧的；
words.ex: He is a skillful painter who draws beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有技巧的画家，能画出美丽的风景。
words.en: Someone who is skillful at something does it very well.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: He embarrassed himself in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班同学面前让自己丢脸了。
words.en: If you embarrass someone, you make them feel shy, ashamed, or guilty about something.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.ex: She licked her lip before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 她在说话前舔了舔嘴唇。
words.en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: He hurt his jaw when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了下巴。
words.en: The jaw is the part of your face below your mouth that moves when you eat or speak.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.ex: He wiped sweat from his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: The captain sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船长驾驶船穿越了海洋。
words.en: A captain is the person in charge of a ship or an aircraft, or a leader of a team or group.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.ex: His silence suggested he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他并不开心。
words.en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: He works in a factory that makes semiconductors.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家生产半导体的工厂工作。
words.en: A semiconductor is a substance that can conduct electricity under some conditions but not others, making it a good medium for the control of electrical current.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.tr: v. 同意；赞成；“agree”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已一致的；同意的；
words.ex: We agreed to meet at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们同意下午五点见面。
words.en: If people are agreed, they have reached a joint decision on something or have the same opinion about something.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的看法。
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr: adj. 陡峭的；急剧升降的；
words.ex: The mountain has a steep path.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一条陡峭的小路。
words.en: A steep slope or hill is one that is at a sharp angle, rather than being flat or gradual.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: He pulled out a handkerchief to wipe his sweat.
words.ex_cn: 他掏出一块手帕擦汗。
words.en: A handkerchief is a small square piece of fabric which you use for blowing your nose.

words.ex: He is a handsome boy.
words.ex_cn: 他是个英俊的男孩。
words.en: A handsome man is good-looking, usually in a way that is attractive to women. Something that is handsome is large in quantity or impressive in quality.

words.ex: His handwriting is very neat.
words.ex_cn: 他的笔迹非常工整。
words.en: Handwriting is the style of writing that someone uses when they write with a pen or pencil.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: The statesman spoke wisely to calm the nation.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家明智地讲话以安抚国家。
words.en: A statesman is a respected political leader or figure, especially one who has had a long and successful career in politics.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: The two teams decide to unite for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队伍决定在比赛中联合起来。
words.en: If a group of people or things unite or if someone unites them, they join together and act as a group.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: n. 共产主义；一种主张生产资料公有、消除阶级差异的社会制度
words.ex: He believes in communism.
words.ex_cn: 他相信共产主义。
words.en: A political theory derived from Karl Marx, advocating class war and leading to a society in which all property is publicly owned and each person works and is paid according to their abilities and needs.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr:
n. 照料；谨慎；关心；
v. 关心；在意；在乎；
words.ex: The nurse gave the baby good care.
words.ex_cn: 护士给了婴儿很好的照料。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He is presently working at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在一家银行工作。
words.en: At the present time; now. Or in a short time; soon.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: The lion will aggress if it feels threatened.
words.ex_cn: 如果狮子感到受威胁，它会攻击。
words.en: To commence an attack or invasion; to act hostilely.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: Blood circulates in the body.
words.ex_cn: 血液在体内循环。
words.en: To move or cause to move continuously or freely through a closed system or area.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: The school is handling the affair carefully.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在小心处理这件事。
words.en: An affair is a situation or subject that is being dealt with or considered; it can also refer to a secret sexual relationship between two people.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: They accused him of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他们指控他偷了钱。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: The actual cost was lower than expected.
words.ex_cn: 实际成本比预期的低。
words.en: You use actual to emphasize that you are referring to something real or genuine.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.
