words.en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个儿童正在玩玩具。
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: Jesus is the Christ in Christian belief.
words.ex_cn: 在基督教信仰中，耶稣是基督。
words.en: Christ is the title given to Jesus, especially in the Christian religion, and it is also used as a name.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: He called his friend a comrade.
words.ex_cn: 他称他的朋友为同志。
words.en: A comrade is a companion who shares one's activities or is a fellow member of an organization.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.ex: They dine at 7 every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上七点进餐。
words.en: To dine means to eat dinner.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: I envy her for her happy family.
words.ex_cn: 我羡慕她幸福的家庭。
words.en: Envy is the feeling you have when you wish you could have the same thing or quality that someone else has.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.ex: The news was false.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻是虚假的。
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.ex: Warm weather favors plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气有利于植物生长。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favor, you like or support them.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.tr: v. 跌倒；下降；砍伐；“fall”的过去式；
words.ex: He fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔了下来。
words.en: To cut down (a tree); to knock down (a person or animal); the skin of an animal with the hair or wool still on it; fierce or cruel.

words.ex: Please fetch me a glass of water.
words.ex_cn: 请给我拿一杯水来。
words.en: If you fetch something or someone, you go to the place where they are and return with them.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对上的音乐太响了。
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.ex: He sent a message through a messenger.
words.ex_cn: 他通过信使发送了一条消息。
words.en: A messenger is someone who carries messages from one person to another.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: He became a millionaire after selling his app.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉自己的应用后成了百万富翁。
words.en: A millionaire is a person whose wealth amounts to a million or more in currency units such as dollars, pounds, or euros.

words.ex: The bug is five millimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr:
adj. 高尚的；
n. 贵族；
words.ex: He made a noble decision to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个高尚的决定去帮助穷人。
words.en: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr:
n. 大头针；
v. 固定；
words.ex: She stuck a pin on the map.
words.ex_cn: 她在地图上别了一枚大头针。
words.en: A pin is a small piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening pieces of cloth together.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: The North Pole is covered with ice all year round.
words.ex_cn: 北极全年都被冰雪覆盖。
words.en: A pole is a long, thin, rounded piece of wood or metal, used especially for supporting things.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: The savage wolf howled under the moon.
words.ex_cn: 那头野性的狼在月光下嚎叫。
words.en: A savage person or animal is very fierce and violent.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.ex: The tree casts a long shadow at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳下，树投下长长的影子。
words.en: A shadow is a dark shape on a surface that is made when something stands between a light and the surface.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.ex: He speaks slowly, using an adverb to describe how he talks.
words.ex_cn: 他说话很慢，用一个副词来描述他说话的方式。
words.en: An adverb is a word that modifies a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, often answering questions such as how?, when?, where?, or to what extent?.

words.ex: The word 'happy' is an adjective.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'happy' 是一个形容词。
words.en: An adjective is a word that describes a noun or pronoun. In grammar, an adjective is a word whose main syntactic role is to modify a noun or pronoun, giving more information about the noun or pronoun's referent.

words.ex: He used 'in' as a preposition in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用 'in' 作为介词。
words.en: A preposition is a word such as 'by', 'for', 'into', or 'with' which usually has a noun group as its object.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: He used 'she' as a pronoun in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用'she'作为代词。
words.en: A pronoun is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase. Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.ex_cn: 书在包里。
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上。
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把球朝窗户扔去。
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: He is among the best students in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最好的学生之一。
words.en: If you are among a group of things or people, you are surrounded by them or part of them.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球升上了天空。
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船离开了岸边。
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: The cat jumped into the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳进了盒子里。
words.en: If you go into a place or thing, you move from the outside to the inside of it.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 他走出了房间。
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校走回家。
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.ex_cn: 我两天前见过他。
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎完成了作业。
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.ex: Does anybody know the answer?
words.ex_cn: 有人知道答案吗？
words.en: Any person at all; anyone.

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.ex: Anyone can learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 任何人都能学会阅读。
words.en: Any person at all; it does not matter who.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她到处找她的钥匙。
words.en: in or to all places

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 很少有人来参加会议。
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶或者咖啡。
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.ex_cn: 我需要吃点东西。
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我有时走路去学校。
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了这样的大错。
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.ex_cn: 我醒来的时候吃早餐。
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.ex_cn: 书在哪里？
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.
